source: Published FordEngage enrollment page plan cards
combination_key_rule: products sorted by JS Array.prototype.sort() (lexicographic, joined with +)
quote_required_note: FordEngage+eStore and VDP Widget+eStore (JS sort: VDP Widget+eStore) are not listed as published plan options. These combinations require a custom quote.
term_note: The published plan cards reference 12-month and 24-month terms for FordEngage and VDP Widget. The source agreement §3.1 allows termination with 30 days written notice and does not impose a minimum term. No minimum-term lock is added to this agreement. The plan card term labels describe the pricing program context only.
